Service Areas — Dhanusha, Mahottari, Siraha & Madhesh

Murli Chowk (Airport Road), Janakpur Dham-8, Dhanusha, Madhesh Province, Nepal · Open 7 days · Google Maps

The workshop is in Janakpur Dham, but the work is Madhesh-wide. If you are building on the East-West Highway — Dhalkebar, Bardibas, Lahan — you do not need to hire a Kathmandu fabricator. We measure, fabricate in Murli Chowk, and install with the same crew that works inside the city.

District coverage

  • Dhanusha — Janakpur Dham, Dhalkebar, Dhanushadham, Mahendranagar, Shahidnagar, Chhireshwarnath, Kamala, Mithila, Nagarain, Bateshwar, Hansapur.
  • Mahottari — Jaleshwor, Gaushala, Bardibas, Matihani, Aurahi.
  • Siraha — Lahan and adjoining bazaars.
  • Sarlahi — Malangwa.
  • Saptari / further — Rajbiraj on scheduled runs; Birgunj, Hetauda and Kathmandu by dispatch.

Highway projects get a morning measurement slot so the engineer is back at the workshop to cut the same afternoon. WhatsApp your landmark (for example “Dhalkebar chowk, 200 m south”) and a photo of the opening.

नेपालीमा

धनुषा, महोत्तरी (जलेश्वर, बर्दीबास), सिरहा (लहान), सर्लाही (मलङ्गवा) र मधेशभर निःशुल्क साइट नाप। बनाउने काम जनकपुरधाम मुरली चोकमै, फिटिङ तपाईंको साइटमा। ह्वाट्सएप +९७७ ९८१७६५८७१९।

Questions from Janakpur clients

Do you visit Jaleshwor, Lahan and Bardibas for free?

Yes. Free laser measurement for genuine building work in Mahottari (Jaleshwor, Gaushala, Bardibas), Siraha (Lahan), Sarlahi (Malangwa), Dhanusha (Dhalkebar, Dhanushadham) and adjoining districts. Installation crews are scheduled after the quote.

Can you deliver to Kathmandu or Birgunj?

Yes. Frames are factory-finished in Janakpur and dispatched Nepal-wide. Large curtain walls and temple gates travel with our own fitting team.
